school.school_name: 大宮スイーツ＆カフェ専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the Sanko sweets disclosure-page case where the latest public confirmation form is still FY2025.
steps: Start from the Saitama official-index URL registered as https://www.sanko.ac.jp/disclosure/omiya-sweets/.
Inspect the disclosure page's visible yearly confirmation-form links.
Observe that the latest visible target-form candidate is yoshiki2025.pdf with anchor text 2025年度.
Reject the PDF from strict FY2026 success as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025.
Keep prior yoshiki2020-2024 files as old-year history, not as current target-FY success.

reusable_rules: Treat 2025年度/yoshiki2025.pdf as latest-public target-form evidence, not as FY2026 success.
Keep the publication-lag queue visible so the operator can distinguish public-site lag from crawler failure.
Preserve old-year mismatch evidence for the school because it explains why no FY2026 document row exists.
anti_patterns: Do not loosen strict mode to accept stale Sanko forms.
Do not infer the target fiscal year from the current run configuration alone.
Do not send adjacent school-evaluation, course-list, syllabus, or director-compensation PDFs to the target parser.

evidence.notes: Windows v320 bounded Saitama bootstrap crawled this official-index disclosure page, found yoshiki2025.pdf, and rejected it as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 for target FY2026.
